question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

On 25 August 1925, the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance ___________ the establishment of the Central Bank of India.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes an official recommendation made by a commission.
 
• **"Proposed" **suggests putting forward a plan or suggestion for consideration**.(प्रस्तावित)**
 
• **"proposed"** best fits the context of a commission recommending the establishment of a bank.
 
• Hence, The correct blank is **'Proposed.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

Correct sentence is__ **'On 25 august 1925, the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance Proposed the establishment of the Central Bank of India.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (2) - "Defined"(परिभाषित)**** **implies giving a specific meaning to something. It doesn't convey the idea of suggesting the establishment.
 
• **Option (3) - "Figured" (अनुमान लगाना)** can mean to calculate or estimate, but it's not an appropriate verb in this context.
 
• **Option (4) - "Censored" (नियंत्रक)** means to suppress or disapprove of something. It has the opposite meaning of recommending something.
